scope: Sealed-profile qualification of complete requirement manifests, sequential/parallel preparation at worker counts 1/2/4/8, parent-bound WAL/CAS publication, DurableCoordinationStore generation CAS, fenced worktree lifecycle, and restart recovery. Federation/network partitions and libp2p/MCP transport remain unavailable. Not a live A–D experiment, not a Groth16 proof of pytest execution, and not an external exactly-once side-effect claim beyond the tested hermetic WAL/CAS/lifecycle boundary.

prior_capability_boundary.classification: NS-002 recorded incremental_proof_sealer blocked because ipfs_datasets_py.logic.zkp.incremental_sealing was absent. NS-012 confirmed that package and nested ipfs_kit_py.proof_seal_store remain absent from the pinned trees, installed labeled contract-faithful shims, and exercised the accelerate sealer, DurableCoordinationStore, and WorktreeLifecycleStore live.

criteria.criterion: Sequential/parallel bytes, roots, inventories, and dispositions match on identical inputs; worker order cannot alter authority.
criteria.explanation: Preparation at worker counts 1, 2, 4, and 8 under a frozen canonical-json/sha256 profile produced identical leaf roots, inventories, full-checkpoint seal CID sha256:25180cd72df48fc18f236e9d36799c35b9c9dc765da65bf3cc206cedfd8eab7a, manifest root sha256:da6bf080c464f75151fd4c367938c02e71114030392dd8082d550dc449fd1dd9, repository proof root, and aggregation root. Hash memo keys content plus codec/hash/canonicalization/source-mode and reverifies; mtime-only keys are rejected. Worker completion order varied; the serial barrier kept authority unchanged.

criteria.criterion: An empty or incomplete manifest cannot pass a mandatory obligation; membership alone is never completeness.
criteria.explanation: create_full_checkpoint returned incomplete_manifest and sealed=false for an empty required set, a missing mandatory unit, and a presented subset that did not equal the requirement manifest. Duplicate unit identities raised FullCheckpointError. Manifest aggregation rejected missing_child, duplicate_child, and reordered_children. Merkle membership of some units never authorized a complete seal.

criteria.criterion: Stale/late/failed writers cannot replace the accepted root or invent task success.
criteria.explanation: A delta against a superseded parent returned stale_parent without moving the current pointer. Six concurrent same-parent writers produced exactly one published generation; losers were stale_parent. A pre-CAS crash and a failed required unit left the accepted root unchanged. DurableCoordinationStore rejected an ABA-stale generation token (RootConflict). WorktreeLifecycleStore denied a duplicate live claim and a forged fence. Unknown proof systems and simulated required units could not admit or seal.

criteria.criterion: Restart retains admitted evidence and resumes a useful valid task without unobserved duplicate effects; external exactly-once behavior is not claimed beyond the tested boundary.
criteria.explanation: A crash after CAS and before cleanup left the pointer on seal sha256:25180cd72df48fc18f236e9d36799c35b9c9dc765da65bf3cc206cedfd8eab7a. recover_publication recognized pointer_matches_seal, committed cleanup, and recognize_post_cas_success reported recovered_success. A second recovery was committed_prefix/idempotent. A pre-CAS crash left no current pointer; a subsequent valid publish resumed a sealed task. Duplicate recovery events did not invent a second success. Recovery receipts set exactly_once_external_claimed=false. Network partition, libp2p/MCP transport, and remote stores remain unavailable.

criteria.criterion: Prepare/verify/persist/CAS CPU/memory/storage/elapsed measurements are real and separately labeled.
criteria.explanation: The measurements_separately_labeled case recorded actual prepare, verify, persist, and CAS elapsed (time.perf_counter, ms), CPU (time.process_time, ms), peak RSS (resource.getrusage, bytes), and storage (canonical/store bytes). GPU time is unavailable with an explicit reason because no accelerator exists in the sealed PATH. Overlapping parallel stage times are not added as one physical quantity.
